title: Ninario
body:
## 📌 GENERAL INFORMATION:
- Server IP   : ninar.io
- Version     : 1.21.4+ (Premium)
- Game Modes  : Original PvP Minigames & Survival
- Combat System: PvP 1.9+ New Gen

## ✨ ABOUT NINARIO:
Ninario is an innovative Minecraft server designed for PvP and 
Survival enthusiasts. All available minigames are fully developed 
in-house by our dedicated team to guarantee a unique, smooth, and 100% original 
experience! Thanks to regular updates, the content is constantly 
evolving.

## 🎮 OUR GAME MODES & FEATURES:
» Exclusive PvP Minigames: Unique, custom-coded modes featuring 
competitive mechanics and guaranteed fun.

» Survival Mode: A chill, Farm2Win-oriented adventure where you 
can build, trade, and progress at your own pace.

» Rank System: Exclusive ranks tailored for everyone, alongside 
special statuses for content creators ("Fameux" & "Mini-Fameux").

## 📜 ESSENTIAL RULES & GUIDELINES:
» Anti-Cheat: Use of modified clients or unfair advantages is 
strictly forbidden (KillAura, Fly, Reach, etc.).

» Fair Play: Cross-teaming and bug exploitation are punishable. 
Report any issues using the command: /bugreport <bug>

» Respect: The in-game chat must remain calm and respectful. Any 
hateful, discriminatory, or toxic behavior will result in a ban.

## 🔗 OFFICIAL LINKS:
» Wiki / GitBook  : https://ninariomc.gitbook.io/ninario

» Website         : https://ninario.fr/

» Server IP       : ninar.io (1.21.4+)

Ready to join the adventure? Connect right now!
